metadata.description: Comprehensive endometriosis symptom library. Every symptom is weighted by clinical significance. Score is calculated by summing (weight x severity_modifier) for all reported symptoms, then applying duration and history modifiers.
metadata.scoring_note: Base score = sum of (symptom.weight x severity_modifier). Final score = base_score x duration_modifier x history_modifier. ESI tier assigned from scoring_rules.json.

plain_language_aliases: I cannot move during my period
pain that makes me stay in bed
period pains so bad I faint
my time of the month is unbearable

mild.description: Noticeable period pain, manageable without medication or with paracetamol

moderate.description: Significant pain requiring strong painkillers (ibuprofen, mefenamic acid), limits some activities

severe.description: Severe pain, unable to work or attend school, painkillers partially effective

critical.description: Incapacitating pain, fainting, vomiting, emergency care sought, no pain relief

symptoms.notes: Highest weighted symptom. Core diagnostic indicator per NICE 2024 and rASRM.

user_descriptors: affects every part of my life

symptoms.notes: Pain persisting more than 6 months strongly associated with endometriosis. Stage increases with chronicity.

plain_language_aliases: pelvic pain a week before my period

user_descriptors: pain for two weeks before period

symptoms.notes: Pain beginning well before menstruation is a distinguishing feature of endometriosis vs primary dysmenorrhoea.
